name: ABIVAX Société Anonyme
summary:
ABIVAX Société Anonyme (ABVX) reported a loss of $1.71 per share on revenue of $1.40 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $1.08 per share on revenue of $1.86 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 58.33%.

Abivax is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing therapeutics that harness the body’s natural regulatory mechanisms to stabilize the immune response in patients with chronic inflammatory diseases
subject: ABIVAX Société Anonyme Missed Consensus Estimates
